description: Replace the small-matrix path with a custom batched CUDA Cholesky kernel that assigns warps or blocks per matrix, stages tiles in shared memory, and fuses factorization work to expose parallelism for n=32 through n=256.

Packed lower-triangle shared-memory Cholesky for n=32,64,128,256; local CUDA 13.0 build passed, but Modal CUDA 13.3 compilation failed because the CUDA translation unit forced C++17 against C++20 PyTorch headers.

Portable C++20 packed shared-memory one-block-per-matrix Cholesky for n=32,64,128,256; all official and fresh-seed guards passed. Small timings 38.298/71.376/178.624/616.999 us; full-grid geomean 2029.257 us.
Four-thread row teams for n=64,128,256 passed all guards. Small timings 39.061/80.099/168.364/478.363 us: n=128 and n=256 improved, n=64 regressed; full-grid geomean measured 2056.456 us.

Broadened packed-kernel warp barrier helper to n=64, but the live dispatch remained the four-thread cooperative kernel at n=64. All guards passed; small timings 38.237/79.261/169.260/480.828 us and full-grid geomean 2003.322 us.

Hybrid row strategy: single row thread for n=32,64 and four-thread row teams for n=128,256. All official and fresh-seed guards passed; small timings 38.404/71.631/167.562/478.080 us; full-grid geomean 1956.065 us.

Pipelined each next pivot into the row team finishing the prior column, halving cooperative-path block barriers. All guards passed; small timings 38.355/71.571/161.520/447.614 us; full-grid geomean 1927.448 us.
Eight-thread n=128 row teams passed all guards but measured 167.340 us versus 161.520 us with four-thread teams; other small timings 38.347/71.559/447.220 us. Full-grid geomean 1949.578 us.

Packed eight independent n=32 matrices into each 256-thread block and restored four-thread n=128 teams. All guards passed; n=32 measured 40.933 us versus 38.355 us for one-warp blocks, other small timings 72.230/161.551/448.293 us; full geomean 1939.817 us.

Restored one-warp n=32 blocks and tested two-thread n=128 row teams. All guards passed; n=128 measured 183.585 us versus 161.520/167.340 us for widths 4/8; other small timings 38.193/71.923/448.177 us; full geomean 1956.081 us.

Restored four-thread n=128 teams and tested two-thread n=256 teams under the same 132 KiB shared footprint. All guards passed; n=256 measured 540.299 us versus 447.614 us at width 4; other small timings 37.913/71.336/161.391 us; full geomean 1990.448 us.

Added one shared-memory padding element per cooperative row and restored four-thread teams. All guards passed; n=128/n=256 measured 163.103/456.520 us versus 161.520/447.614 us unpadded; n=32/n=64 38.272/71.412 us; full geomean 2027.039 us.

Replaced n=256 fused block with a correct 64x64 tiled copy/panel/TRSM/update schedule exposing hundreds of trailing-update blocks. All guards passed; n=256 measured 608.897 us versus 447.614 us fused; n=32/64/128 38.470/71.625/161.562 us; full geomean 2014.687 us.

Changed the correct n=256 tiled schedule from 64x64 to 32x32 tiles, increasing first-stage useful update blocks to 1792. All guards passed; n=256 improved from 608.897 to 494.161 us but remained above fused 447.614 us; full geomean 2042.069 us.

Restored the fused four-thread n=128/n=256 kernels and pipelined each next pivot into the n=32/n=64 row solve, halving their barriers. All guards passed; small timings 38.087/69.836/161.463/446.999 us; full geomean 1969.160 us.

Built and measured 14 trials. Lowest full-grid geomean was 1927.448 us at 076fa1e (baseline 2153.690 us, 1.117x speedup): packed one-row kernels gave 2029.257, four-thread n128/n256 teams cut their shapes to 168.364/478.363, size-specialized dispatch gave 1956.065, and one-barrier cooperative pivot pipelining reached 161.520/447.614 and 1927.448 overall. Width sweeps measured n128 183.585/161.520/167.340 us for 2/4/8 threads and n256 540.299/447.614 us for 2/4. Eight n32 matrices per block measured 40.933 versus 38.355 us; padded shared rows measured 163.103/456.520. Correct tiled n256 schedules measured 608.897 us at tile64 and 494.161 us at tile32. Final c642ef5 also pipelined n32/n64, measuring 38.087/69.836/161.463/446.999 us and 1969.160 overall. Every succeeded design passed all official tests and six fresh-seed n256 families; profiling was waived by the run contract. Keep this line moving: open variants include a register-resident fully unrolled n32 warp, grouped n64 matrices, tiled n256 updates with 4x4 register microtiles and coalesced padded panels, one-barrier tiled panel/TRSM kernels, and tile16 or hybrid fused/tiled schedules.
